Third-party libraries, stored here so the site works offline and does not depend on other servers.
Each file keeps its own license notice at the top.

marked.min.js            marked 12.0.2            MIT license          https://github.com/markedjs/marked
purify.min.js            DOMPurify 3.1.6          Apache-2.0 / MPL-2.0 https://github.com/cure53/DOMPurify
highlight.min.js         highlight.js 11.9.0      BSD-3-Clause         https://github.com/highlightjs/highlight.js
atom-one-dark.min.css    highlight.js theme       BSD-3-Clause

To update one: download the new minified file with the same name and replace it, then test a lesson with code in it.
